pilot_gate: local AP75 > matched query control AP75; local precise representative count > matched control; local TP_FP6 >= matched control and >= prior MAL+UQ
detector: frozen cached boxes and query features
crop: predicted bbox expanded 1.5x; original teammate grayscale image; 16x16 bilinear sample; border padding; no GT in extraction
local_features: 256 mean-centered/std-normalized pixels with std floor .02 plus intensity mean and std
control_features: 256 query features plus 2 log-size features; duplicated branch input matches 258 dimensions; query-only control has identical parameter count
head: frozen original UQ + zero-initialized residual MLP on original283 and branch258 features
train: 30 epochs; AdamW lr .0001 wd .0001; batch16; modulated quality loss + .1 hard pair logistic; last epoch; paired init/data order
evaluation: same original-coordinate COCO evaluator; NMS .7; scale1; fixed base-score>=.001 support; no validation tuning
secondary: zero-local input intervention is diagnostic only, out of distribution, no refitting
